title: Seven Days to One Loaf
moral: The first try is supposed to be ugly. It still counts.
notes: Demo script for the video-plan-page skill. Every picture is still to paint, so the animatic shows the shot notes.
titles: I Grew Yeast From Nothing (Day 1 to 7)
My First Sourdough Was Ugly. I Ate It Anyway.

thumbs.brief: Maya's hands holding a lopsided loaf toward the camera, warm kitchen light, flour on her sleeve.
Split frame: empty jar on the left, the finished loaf on the right.

checks.name: quest stated by 10 s
checks.info: goal and deadline in the first two lines

quest.goal: bake one loaf from a starter she grows herself
quest.opening: cold open on the empty jar

hooks.text: Maya has never baked bread. She has seven days.
Seven days. One jar. No yeast from the store.
Day three, her starter smelled like old socks.
I tried to grow bread from flour and water.
The bakery opens at eight. She didn't go.

lines.text: Maya has never baked bread. | She has seven days.
lines.see: Close on an empty jar on a kitchen counter, morning light, a bag of flour beside it.

lines.text: One loaf. | Made from a starter she grows herself.
lines.see: Maya stirs flour and water in the jar with a wooden spoon.

lines.text: just buy one. | the bakery opens at eight.

lines.see: The jar on the windowsill. No bubbles. Maya leans in, frowning.

lines.text: Day three. It smells like old socks.
lines.see: Maya holds the jar at arm's length.

lines.text: She reads one line on a flour bag: | feed it twice a day.
lines.see: Macro on the printed instructions, a thumb under the words.
The starter has doubled, glossy bubbles at the glass.

lines.text: Day six. The dough tears every time she folds it.
lines.see: Wet dough ripping between her fingers.

lines.text: eight a.m. warm bread. | no tearing.
Day seven. She waits. | Four more hours.
lines.see: The oven light on, Maya sitting on the floor watching through the glass.
The loaf comes out: dark crust, a crack across the top.

lines.text: It's flat. It's lopsided. | It's hers.
lines.see: She tears the loaf open; steam rises. She eats the first piece standing up.
The empty jar, refilled, back on the counter. Card holds.
